scope: CLOUD08 report-history three-finding repairs, malformed-data handling, metadata preflight and historical job/owner linkage

resolved_findings.evidence: Both pure record validators require text report/payload columns and a decoded dictionary with string values before encoding/iteration. The Paper producer-instance guard checks nonempty bounded text before .encode, and the final SQL retrieval also restricts typeof/byte length before transferring that producer identity. Expected malformed persisted values reach typed sanitized denial.

A SQL preflight checks fixed metadata types/byte lengths and integer fields before operation identities are fetched. Report rows are decoded lazily one at a time with per-field predicates, so the larger single-checkpoint allowance no longer permits an oversized metadata page. Invalid rows fail rather than disappear from counts/paging.

The reader compares family_id and seed/random_seed in addition to namespace/submission/implementation/strategy, and checks completed outcome.run_id against persisted owner_run_id. It rechecks the job owner binding after the report snapshot. The updated genuine second-owner test first exercises the completed outcome check, then aligns that outcome and independently requires rejection of differing family/seed.

static_test_assessment: Schema-preserving payload and aggregate-hash corruption tests restore the exact original owned trigger, avoiding premature schema-only rejection.
The oversized metadata test traps attempted report-row materialization and requires failure at the SQL preflight.
The historical producer BLOB regression corrupts a genuine generation while restoring its exact immutable trigger/schema and requires typed history denial.
Actual separate owner, queue-binding change and no-writer/no-regeneration tests remain source component fixtures; no tests were run by this reviewer.
policy_mapping_limit: Policy refs are opaque historical paths and selection_hash is resolver-specific. This read-only route verifies persisted owner binding and directly available arguments; without a retained selection snapshot it does not independently reconstruct each path-to-historical-policy mapping. No current-file/resolver read is added and no financial/eligibility authority follows from this delivery metadata.
limits: Static source reads and raw-byte hashing only; no tests/native/product/process execution, Git changes, DB/auth/config/provider/network access or tracked writes.
Root-reported fail-first/pass observations are development evidence, not reviewer execution.
Existing Windows7d qualification stays on its original subject/scope. These WIP source changes receive no installed-native, real-cloud, financial, whole-product or Master acceptance credit.
